name: Kumatori (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kumatori town emblem in white: an outlined eight-pointed star enclosing a swirl of rays.
history: Municipal flag of Kumatori, a town in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 3 November 1981; the emblem dates from 3 November 1951.

features.role: Kumatori town emblem — an outlined eight-pointed star enclosing a swirl of rays
